title: Understanding the Structure and Apo Dynamics of the Functionally Active JIP1 Fragment.
authors: Ojaghlou, Neda; Airas, Justin; McRae, Lauren M; Taylor, Cooper A; Miller, Bill R 3rd; Parish, Carol A
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD模拟和马尔可夫状态模型研究功能活性JIP1无序片段的结构与apo态动力学，聚焦单链构象动态而非PPI，方法可迁移但互作轴缺失。
abstract: Recent experiments indicate that the C-Jun amino-terminal kinase-interacting protein 1 (JIP1) binds to and activates the c-Jun N-terminal kinase (JNK) protein. JNK is an integral part of cell apoptosis, and misregulation of this process is a causative factor in diseases such as Alzheimer's disease (AD), obesity, and cancer. It has also been shown that JIP1 may increase the phosphorylation of tau by facilitating the interaction between the tau protein and JNK, which could also be a causative factor in AD. Very little is known about the structure and dynamics of JIP1; however, the amino acid composition of the first 350 residues suggests that it contains an intrinsically disordered region. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations using AMBER 14 were used to study the structure and dynamics of a functionally active JIP1 10mer fragment to better understand the solution behavior of the fragment. Two microseconds of unbiased MD was performed on the JIP1 10mer fragment in 10 different seeds for a total of 20 mus of simulation time, and from this, seven structurally stable conformations of the 10mer fragment were identified via classical clustering. The 10mer ensemble was also used to build a Markov state model (MSM) that identified four metastable states that encompassed six of the seven conformational families identified by classical dimensional reduction. Based on this MSM, conformational interconversions between the four states occur via two dominant pathways with probability fluxes of 55 and 44% for each individual pathway. Transitions between the initial and final states occur with mean first passage times of 31 (forward) and 16 (reverse) mus.
abstract_zh: 近期实验表明，C-Jun氨基末端激酶相互作用蛋白1（JIP1）能结合并激活c-Jun N末端激酶（JNK）蛋白。JNK是细胞凋亡的重要组成部分，该过程的失调是阿尔茨海默病（AD）、肥胖症和癌症等疾病的致病因素。研究还显示，JIP1可能通过促进tau蛋白与JNK之间的相互作用来增加tau的磷酸化，这也可能是AD的一个致病因素。关于JIP1的结构和动态特性知之甚少；然而，其前350个残基的氨基酸组成提示其含有一个内在无序区域。利用AMBER 14进行的分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟被用来研究功能活跃的JIP1 10mer片段的结构和动态，以更好地理解该片段在溶液中的行为。对JIP1 10mer片段在10个不同种子中进行了总计20微秒的无偏MD模拟，并从中通过经典聚类识别出该10mer片段的七种结构稳定构象。此外，利用10mer集合构建了马尔可夫状态模型（MSM），该模型识别出四个亚稳态，涵盖了经典降维所识别的七个构象家族中的六个。基于此MSM，四个状态之间的构象转换主要通过两条主导路径发生，每条路径的概率通量分别为55%和44%。初始状态与最终状态之间的转换平均首次通过时间为31（正向）和16（反向）微秒。
